items.title: Add an "Updated At" timestamp column so readers can spot new roles
items.description:
The `Date Posted` column is day-level only, so when new roles get added between refreshes there's no way to tell which rows are new since my last visit — I have to re-scan the whole table from the top and remember where I left off.

Proposal: add a column (e.g. `Updated At`) showing the date + time each row was added or updated by the bot, like:

| Company | Job Title | Location | Date Posted | Updated At |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Company A | ... | ... | Sep 29 | Sep 29, 13:53 |
| Company B | ... | ... | Sep 29 | Sep 29, 17:54 |

This should be feasible since the bot already knows when it inserts each row (the timestamp is implicit in the commit history today) — persisting it per-row just makes it visible to everyone. Readers could then instantly see what's new since their last refresh.

items.title: SENWORKS -  CLOUD ENGINEER  (Azure Platform / IaC) - [REMOTE] - USD3000
items.description:
# Cloud Engineer (Azure Platform / IaC)

**Sen Works Viet Nam Co., Ltd.**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Job Title** | Cloud Engineer (Azure Platform / IaC) |
| **Department** | IT Services – Infrastructure & Cloud |
| **Reports To** | Head of Infrastructure / Client Technical Lead [to be confirmed] |
| **Employment Type** | Full-time labour contract with Sen Works Viet Nam Co., Ltd.; probation of up to 60 days |
| **Work Location** | Vietnam – fully remote |
| **Salary Range** | Up to USD3000 gross |

📩 **Apply:** send your CV to [jobs@senworks.com](mailto:jobs@senworks.com)

---

## Role Summary

In this role you will be dedicated to a US healthcare services client that operates a growing network of affiliated medical practices. You will work inside the client's Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment and collaborate daily with the client's US-based teams on systems that store, process or transmit protected health information (PHI).

The Cloud Engineer is the principal designer and builder of the client's cloud platform. You will lead cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, platform automation and cloud operations, building the landing zones, guardrails and delivery pipelines that give product, data and integration teams a secure, compliant, cost-effective foundation for PHI workloads.

## Key Responsibilities

### Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering

- Design and implement Azure architecture: landing zones, subscription and tenant structure, identity integration, networking, governance and the platform foundation for Azure Virtual Desktop.
- Deliver the platform through infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), policy as code and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes.
- Set reference architectures, naming and tagging standards and environment patterns.
- Lead migration of on-premises and practice-site workloads to Azure, including dependency mapping, cutover planning and decommissioning.

### Cloud Operations, Reliability & Cost

- Lead observability, monitoring, alerting and incident response for cloud platforms; drive root cause analysis and reliability improvements.
- Align configuration, identity, encryption, key management and logging with HIPAA, HITRUST and SOC 2 in partnership with Information Security.
- Design and test backup, DR and business continuity to meet defined RTO and RPO.
- Use cost and utilisation data to right-size resources and apply reservations and savings plans.

### Enablement & Integration

- Build reusable modules, pipelines and documentation so teams can deploy compliant workloads without bespoke engineering.
- Design secure connectivity and data exchange between cloud, on-premises systems, practice sites and third-party healthcare platforms.
- Conduct design and code reviews; define measures for availability, deployment frequency, change success rate and cost efficiency, and report to leadership.

## Qualifications

### Education & Certifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, certifications and experience will be considered.
- **Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)** or equivalent expert-level cloud certification required; DevOps, security or networking certifications preferred.

### Experience

- 5+ years of infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including at least 4 years designing and operating production workloads in Azure or a comparable public cloud.
- Experience leading cloud migrations and greenfield builds, including landing zone design, networking and identity integration.
- Proven success improving reliability, deployment velocity and cloud cost efficiency through automation.
- Experience building cloud environments that meet HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 requirements.
- Healthcare, healthcare technology or managed services experience is a strong advantage.

### Knowledge & Skills

- Terraform or Bicep with Git-based workflows; Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
- Azure networking and security: VNets, private endpoints, ExpressRoute/VPN, RBAC, Azure Policy, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud and Entra ID.
- Azure Well-Architected Framework and Cloud Adoption Framework.
- Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, AKS), serverless patterns and SRE practices.
- PowerShell, Python or Bash; Azure Monitor and Log Analytics; cloud cost management.
- HIPAA, the shared responsibility model and BAAs with cloud providers (training provided).
- Professional English (spoken and written) for daily work with US-based colleagues and clients.

## Working Conditions

- Flexible working hours, with an agreed daily overlap window with US-based teams for meetings and real-time collaboration.
- Fully remote from Vietnam; no business travel or on-site attendance is required.

## What We Offer

- 💰 Salary reviewed annually.
- 🏠 Flexible working hours and fully remote work – no travel or on-site attendance required.
- 🎁 13th-month salary and performance bonus.
- 🌙 Night-shift allowance in accordance with the Vietnam Labour Code for any hours worked at night.
- 🏥 Full social, health and unemployment insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law, plus private healthcare insurance.
- 📚 Company-sponsored certifications and training budget.
- 💻 Company-managed laptop and equipment.
- 🌴 Annual leave of at least 12 days plus Vietnamese public holidays.
- 🌍 Long-term work with international teams.

---

## How to Apply

Send your CV to **[jobs@senworks.com](mailto:jobs@senworks.com)** with the subject line: `Cloud Engineer (Azure Platform / IaC) – [Your Name]`

Hello Europe Tech Internships 2026 team,

My script already reads your public job listings once a day and shows the title, organization, location, date and a link back to your page. Nothing is sold.

Could you tell me if this is OK with you, or what you would prefer? If you would rather I stop, tell me and I will stop it within a few days and remove your listings.

I can send the full technical details (every request, what is stored) if that is useful.

Thank you,
Manuchehr Qoriev
OmniLadders · omniladders@gmail.com · https://omniladders.pages.dev

items.title: Question about reading public listings on Visa-Sponsored Jobs List (personal final-year project)
items.description:
Hello Visa-Sponsored Jobs List team,

I'm Manuchehr Qoriev, a computer science student. OmniLadders (https://omniladders.pages.dev) is my own personal final-year project, free and non-commercial, and not run by any university or organization. It helps students around the world find internships and graduate roles.

My script already reads your public job listings, normally once a day, and I would like to check that this is OK with you. For each job the site shows the title, employer, location and a link to the job, and the date where your list gives one, plus a few things derived from the advert (tags, a visa note, a fit score). The same list is also a public file anyone can download. Nothing is sold. This repository has no licence file, so I am asking rather than assuming, and I would be glad to credit it with a link back.

Could you tell me if this is fine, or what you would prefer (a lower rate, an API or feed, only some fields)? If someone else handles this, please forward it.

If you would rather I stop, tell me. I will block it within a few days, so that from the next daily run after that there are no more requests and your listings leave the site, and I will delete the advert text I stored.

Thank you,
Manuchehr Qoriev
OmniLadders · omniladders@gmail.com · https://omniladders.pages.dev

Technical details, in case someone asks:
- Requests, once a day (1 in all; a failed request is retried at most twice):
    GET raw.githubusercontent.com/Lamiiine/Awesome-daily-list-of-visa-sponsored-jobs/main/jobList.json (the list, one request)
  They send the headers of Chrome on macOS; I can switch to "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; OmniLadders/1.0; +https://omniladders.pages.dev)" if you prefer.
- Link check: once a day, a HEAD request to the link of each job shown on the site (your job page or, where a listing provides one, the employer's own application page), following redirects (plus a GET on 403, 404, 405, 410 or a server error), as "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; OmniLadders/1.0; +https://omniladders.pages.dev)".
- Stored privately: the advert text, where your site provides it, used to work out labels (visa, degree, experience, language); not published in full. An occasional manual check may send, at most, a job's title, employer, location, link and up to about 2,000 characters of its text to a third-party AI service (Google Gemini or OpenAI).
- Published: title, employer, location, date, salary if given, a few tags derived from the advert, a visa note, a computed fit score and a link (also as https://omniladders.pages.dev/jobs.json), plus a short quote where an advert states a visa, experience or language requirement.

### 📋 Descrição da Vaga

🚀 Buscamos um profissional mão na massa, com mentalidade de automação e melhoria contínua, capaz de planejar e executar migrações controladas, criar ambientes de staging/sandbox, e atuar junto ao time de desenvolvimento para entregar sistemas mais estáveis e seguros.

→  Responsabilidades:

- Gerenciar e otimizar nossos clusters Kubernetes (EKS), garantindo organização, observabilidade e segurança.
- Administrar serviços AWS (IAM, MSK/Kafka, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, EC2, VPC, CloudWatch, Route53, etc.).
- Implementar e manter Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CDK).
- Criar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, etc.), com foco em segurança e automação.
- Planejar e executar migrações de serviços, como upgrades do Kestra, FusionAuth, ClickHouse, etc.
- Monitorar e otimizar custos, performance e disponibilidade da infraestrutura.
- Implementar boas práticas de segurança: políticas IAM, gestão de segredos, scans de vulnerabilidade, hardening de containers.
- Trabalhar junto ao time de engenharia para garantir que o ciclo de desenvolvimento e deploy seja seguro, confiável e auditável.

### ✅ Requisitos Técnicos

```markdown
→ Qualificações

- Experiência sólida com Kubernetes (EKS) — deployments, autoscaling, ingress, RBAC, secrets, network policies, etc.
- Domínio de AWS (IAM, VPC, EC2, RDS, MSK, Lambda, CloudWatch, etc.).
- Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, AWS CDK ou similares).
- Experiência com CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Jenkins, etc.).
- Conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, CloudWatch).
- Experiência prática com migrações de serviços e upgrades em produção.
- Conhecimento em boas práticas de segurança em cloud e containers.
- Capacidade de documentar e automatizar processos.

→ Diferenciais

- Experiência com Kestra, FusionAuth, ClickHouse ou Kafka/MSK.
- Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, SysOps, DevOps) ou Kubernetes (CKA/CKS).
- Experiência com DevSecOps (scanners de vulnerabilidade, políticas automatizadas, compliance).
- Vivência com monitoramento de custos e otimização de uso de recursos em cloud.
- Experiência com linguagens de automação (Python, Go, Ruby ou Shell).
```

### 🎁 Benefícios

- Salário: A combinar baseado no nível de experiência
- Modelo: PJ
- Plano de Saúde e Odontológico: Bradesco Saúde, sem coparticipação
- Plano de Bem-estar: Wellhub (Gympass)
- Day Off no Aniversário
- Vale Alimentação: R$700,00
- Local: híbrido, indo ao nosso escritório em Florianópolis 2 vezes por semana (terças e sextas).
- Apoio ao deslocamento para modelo híbrido
 - Incentivamos a presença no escritório com um modelo de apoio ao transporte:
    - 1 ida por semana com Uber pago pela empresa
    - Auxílio adicional por km nos dias presenciais extras (até R$ 1,60/km)
    - R$ 35,00/dia de VR adicional para cada dia no escritório
- Vaga integral. Não esperamos que você pegue qualquer trabalho por fora.
